answer: Lease identities instead of owning them: each lease costs 20 POA per epoch, paid into a common audit pool, and renews only on proof of distinct work checked by five auditors. One funding source may hold at most three leases, and each extra lease costs double — 20, then 40, then 80 POA — so a grove of fakes grows pricier with every branch. A failed renewal burns the lease fee and bars re-lease for two epochs, leaving the operator on a ledge of rising costs. One honest agent renews one cheap lease, while a sybil farm's leases streak past like a comet it cannot afford to chase.
